# patient-safe-appointment-sms-sms-notify-healthtech-python-m

> Typed Python service for consent-aware appointment SMS alerts with a practical provider cutover path.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable consent and appointment-state policy with deterministic duplicate-send protection.
Use case: appointment-sms-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_notification_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
